issues: Scene A was a generic light-grey dashboard and the 44px anchor icon was hard to find at 1080p
Iris and ring were interpolated separately: the ring simply grew inside the iris, so 'this circle becomes that circle' never read
Scene B's ring sat in a corner at r=170 next to 18–22px stat cards: an empty composition with unreadable text
One indigo everywhere, and the old page stood still while the iris opened, so the new scene looked like a round sticker on top
changes: Lime look (graphite with neon yellow-green): scene A is a fictional running-club leaderboard with five rows of 40/60px type, and the neon 'You' avatar on row 3 is the only accent in frame
Focus beat: the other rows dim to ~32%, the avatar pulses twice with two neon ripples, the camera pushes 3% around the anchor, and the avatar shrinks slightly to anticipate

The match is rebuilt as a solid avatar hollowing into a ring: stroke width goes from the full diameter to 44px while the radius grows 36 to 300 (expo-out), and the iris rides the ring's outer edge plus an ease-in blast, so the ring pushes the iris open
The old page scales 1.03 to 1.22 around the anchor and darkens; the iris edge gets a drop shadow and one neon rim light, so the new scene presses down on the old one

Scene B is laid out as a poster: r=300 ring, a concentric stopwatch dial, a 200px counting number, a 120px headline rising word by word, three staggered 60px stats and a rank pill that calls back to scene A
Duration 140 to 165f: the sweep now starts slow with a long tail (58f), followed by a 47f hold with only a slow dial drift and a breathing arc glow
